name: Moto Guzzi Daytona 1000 / Sport 1100
engine: 992 or 1064 cc air-cooled V-twin, four-valve heads on the Daytona, carbs or fuel injection
intro: Guzzi's 90s sport twins. The Daytona has the high-cam four-valve heads, and both have shaft drive.

K: Guzzi big twins use a car-type dry clutch and a separate gearbox and final drive. Change all three oils, not just the engine oil.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
